## 简体中文

- 修复 Windows 升级必须重命名整个资源目录的问题：改为逐文件事务更新，内容未变化的驱动和 DLL 保持原位，避免这些文件的占用阻塞其他资源更新。
- 程序文件替换前先复制旧版备份，再原子替换；资源更新完成后才替换服务程序，避免升级失败时旧版可执行文件被提前移走。
- 新增 Windows 文件占用回归测试，覆盖不变驱动被占用、变化资源被占用以及服务程序替换失败后的旧版保留和资源回滚。

## English

- Fixed Windows upgrades requiring a rename of the entire resources directory. Resources now update through per-file transactions, leaving unchanged drivers and DLLs in place so their handles do not block unrelated resource updates.
- Program replacement now copies the old file to a backup before atomic replacement, and updates the service executable only after application resources are ready, preserving the old executable when activation fails.
- Added Windows lock regression tests covering unchanged locked drivers, changed locked resources, and preservation of the old program with resource rollback when executable replacement fails.
